question: Consider a metallic wire at room temperature. Justify why there is no net current flowing through the wire in the absence of an external electric field.

options.A: The electrons are stationary and do not move.
options.B: The electrons move only in one direction, but their speed is too low.
options.C: The random thermal velocities of electrons are distributed such that the average velocity is zero.
options.D: The number density of electrons is zero in the absence of a field.
